mobile.profile.title: My space
mobile.profile.lead: Your personal activity, settings and services. Your profile visible to the network opens separately.
mobile.profile.profileHint: Your introduction and content accessible to members, according to their audience.
mobile.profile.storiesHint: Your stories and your network's, full screen.
mobile.profile.feedPreferencesHint: Hidden posts and muted authors, to show again whenever you want.
mobile.profile.settingsHint: Display, theme, background pattern, language and time zone.
mobile.profile.personalDataHint: Export, erasure, decisions about you and notifications. Open even during a suspension.
mobile.profile.bookmarksHint: The posts you set aside to come back to.
mobile.profile.activitiesHint: Prepare your presentation and manage your activity storefronts.
mobile.profile.shopHint: Prepare your presentation and manage your activity storefronts.
mobile.profile.cartHint: Up to eight storefronts, each with a cart of up to ten lines. Each order is prepared with one seller; prices, fees and availability are checked again before preparation.
mobile.profile.purchasesHint: Your private commitments with sellers. Order, payment, reservation, fulfillment, receipt and refund remain separate.
mobile.profile.ordersHint: Your private preparations, reservations and deadlines. A preparation does not confirm a payment.
mobile.profile.paymentsHint: View your private attempts and statuses reported by the server. Payment, order, stock and refund are tracked separately.
mobile.profile.serviceRequestsHint: Your quotes, appointments and services requested from professionals. Statuses are those sent by the professional, as of the date shown.
mobile.profile.applicationsHint: Your applications sent through ANTSIA, their status and your withdrawals.
mobile.profile.profileUnavailable: This profile could not be loaded.
mobile.profile.refusedMessage: It does not exist, it is no longer published, or it is not open to you.
mobile.profile.selfNote: This is what others see of you. Nothing else from your account is published.
mobile.profile.emptySelf: You have not published anything yet.
mobile.profile.emptyOther: No post is open to you here.
mobile.profile.postsUnavailable: The posts could not be loaded.
mobile.profile.bookmarksUnavailable: Your saved posts could not be loaded. Nothing was deleted.
mobile.profile.accountDeletionHint: Erasure request in the app, with 30 days to cancel.
